name: A.P.O.L.L.O. Mainframe
notes: Seegson ship/station AI that coordinates Working Joes. Skills: Comtech 5, Piloting 4, Observation 5.

name: MU/TH/UR 6000
notes: Skills: Comtech 5, Piloting 5, Observation 5.

name: MU/TH/UR 6500
notes: Skills: Comtech 6, Piloting 5, Observation 6.

name: MU/TH/UR 7000
notes: Skills: Comtech 7, Piloting 6, Observation 7.

name: MU/TH/UR 9000
notes: Skills: Comtech 10, Piloting 8, Observation 10, Ranged Combat 9.

name: Norcomm 1VAN/3 Computer Mainframe
notes: UPP copy of a Seegson design that governs Fighting Joe androids and can lend them its skills for a Round. Skills: Piloting 4, Ranged Combat 7, Comtech 5, Observation 5, Command 4. With 3+ Joes in combat, roll a Base Die per Joe each Round; a success means that Joe stalls.

name: Long-Data Disc
notes: Nano-optical disc holding up to 10 ZB; EMP-safe backup medium.

name: Magnetic Tape
notes: Cheap cassette holding up to 120 TB; hard for sensor grids to detect.

name: Computer Terminal
notes: Any installed terminal; with codes and COMTECH it can reach whatever MU/TH/UR or A.P.O.L.L.O. knows. Price varies.

name: PR-PUT Portable Remote Pilot Uplink Terminal
notes: Armored laptop with joystick; via a colony uplink and COMTECH it can remote-pilot an orbiting ship.

name: Seegson C-Series Magnetic Tape Recorder
notes: Portable audio recorder/player (price $50-$100).

name: Samani E-Series Watch
notes: Dual-time watch; newer models warn of oxygen and pressure loss.

name: Personal Data Transmitter (PDT)
notes: Broadcasts the wearer's location, sometimes vitals; can be implanted or built into suits.

name: IFF Transponder
notes: Beacon that keeps automated sentry guns from firing on you.

name: Data Transmitter Cards
notes: Plug-in cards that stream audio/video to a synced terminal. The Company Agent option 'with corporate clearance level' is this item.

name: Seegson P-DAT
notes: Personal data tablet that syncs mapping devices, PDTs and helmet cams to coordinate a team.

name: Seegson System Diagnostic Device (SSDD)
notes: Troubleshoots ship and station systems; also handy for hacking doors and terminals.

name: HoloTab
notes: Holographic strategic display table. Table says COMMAND +2; text says COMMAND and OBSERVATION +2.

name: Modular Computing Device
notes: Immersive holographic projector filling a 6x6 m area.

name: Optical Scope
notes: Tiny item. Extends a pistol or rifle's range one category, aimed shots only.

name: Hi-beam Flashlight
notes: Removes the effect of darkness in a zone.

name: Binoculars
notes: Active scouting at LONG range or more only.

effects.text: +2 OBSERVATION at LONG+ range when actively scouting.

name: M314 Motion Tracker
notes: Ultrasonic motion detector: EXTREME range outdoors, LONG indoors. Power Supply roll after every use (Power Supply 5). Can't fire a weapon while using it.

name: M316 Motion Tracker
notes: Experimental rifle-mounted tracker: LONG outdoors, MEDIUM indoors. Power Supply 3.

name: Head-Mounted Sight
notes: Links to smart guns or sentry guns for targeting / remote control.

name: Neuro Visor
notes: Monitor and (with COMTECH) talk to or shape the dreams of someone in hypersleep.

name: W-Y Parameter Uplink Spectrograph Mapping Device ('Pups')
notes: Floating scanner orb: maps one zone per Round, detects enemies in zones it passes, range EXTREME. ACM Forward Observers carry a suppressed version.

name: Seegson Microview-2000SE
notes: Station navigation map that always shows 'you are here'. Price is per deck.

name: Maintenance Jack
notes: Pries unpowered airlocks and reroutes junction-box power.

name: Personal Medkit
notes: Single use: stop bleeding, disinfect, cauterize, bandage, stim.

name: Surgical Kit
notes: Price $25-$200. Base Damage 2 if used as a weapon.

effects.text: +1 MEDICAL AID to prevent death from a fatal critical injury.

name: Pauling MedPod
notes: Autonomous surgical pod; programmed with a COMTECH roll at +2; rolls MEDICAL AID 10 (skill only, cannot push).

name: AutoDoc
notes: Common automated treatment unit for lesser wounds; programmed with an unmodified COMTECH roll; rolls MEDICAL AID 6 (cannot push).

name: Neversleep Pills
notes: Per dose: no need to sleep for a day, but +1 Stress and no stress relief that day.

effects.text: +1 Stress per dose; cannot relieve stress that day.
Removes the need for sleep for one day.

name: Hydr8tion
notes: Electrolyte drink that removes the dehydration caused by hypersleep; no side effects.

name: Naproleve
notes: Injectable painkiller. Each extra dose in the same Shift gives -1 to AGILITY-based rolls until the Shift ends.

name: Recreational Drugs
notes: Legal prescribed vices; $5 for cigarettes up to $60,000 for a kilo of the hard stuff. Effects vary.

name: X-Drugs
notes: Illegal performance stimulants with dangerous side effects; effects and price vary.

name: Water Bottle
notes: Ship water $2, purified bottles $10, up to $100 on barren worlds.

name: 'Bug Juice' Protein Drink
notes: Insect-protein shake.

name: Candy Bar
notes: Price $2-$5.

name: Coffee
notes: Free on most company ships, up to $1.50 a cup. Postpones sleep-deprivation drawbacks for a Shift.

name: Beer
notes: Each drink: -1 Stress but -1 to WITS-based skills for the next Shift.

effects.text: -1 to WITS-based skills for a Shift.

name: Hard Liquor
notes: Price $10-$500 a bottle. Each glass: -1 Stress, -1 to WITS-based skills for the next Shift.

effects.text: -1 to WITS-based skills for a Shift.

name: U-238 Tipped Ammunition ('Dirty Bullets')
notes: Costs four times normal ammo (a normal reload is ~5% of the weapon's price). Lowers target armor by 2 after piercing/doubling; each hit also gives 1 Rad; carrying a loaded weapon gives you 1 Rad per Shift.

name: Signal Flare
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Deck of Cards
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Hand Radio
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Chrome Briefcase
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Gold-Plated Pen
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Rolex Watch
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Fishing Line
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Laser Pointer
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Magnet
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Radio-Controlled Car
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Yo-Yo
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Electronic Handheld Game
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Personal Locator Beacon
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Coloring Pens
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Digital Video Camera
notes: Named only as a career starting option; the CRB gives no weight or price.

name: Acrylic 'Dog Tags' Military ID Key
notes: Encoded ID tags holding medical/personal data and door-lock access by rank.

name: Battledress Utilities (BDUs)
notes: Field uniform in theater-appropriate camouflage.

name: Ghillie Suit
notes: Environment-tailored camouflage with a heat sink that masks infrared.

effects.text: +2 MOBILITY to avoid detection in the matching environment.

name: M3B Standard Boots
notes: Everyday issue boots (table spells it 'MB3').

name: M7 Jungle Boots
notes: For hot, wet environments.

name: Life Vest
notes: Keeps you afloat at the surface; built-in light and a PDT beacon with 2 km range.

name: Cold Weather Parka
notes: Heated hooded parka.

name: UDEP Ultra Diffusive Environmental Poncho
notes: IR-absorbing rain poncho.

effects.text: +2 to stealth in wet environments (book says STEALTH).

name: G-Suit
notes: Pilot's pressure jumpsuit; helmet bottle gives Air Supply 1 when unplugged from the craft.

name: BiMex Personal Shades
notes: When hit by a laser weapon roll a Base Die; on a success the beam is deflected (no damage) but the shades are ruined.

name: CBRN Detection Kit
notes: Geiger counter, agent detector, inhibitor doses, four one-Turn respirators, gloves, goggles, sample kit. Reveals Radiation Level and pathogens at your location.

name: IMP Individual Marine Pack
notes: Waterproof pack with a medkit and Supply 4 of food and water.

effects.text: Carry 2 more regular items before being over-encumbered.

name: TNR High Beam Shoulder Lamp
notes: Hand-held or armor-mounted; removes the effect of darkness in a zone.

name: Muzzle Suppressor
notes: Price $50-$200. Enemies need an OBSERVATION roll to notice the shot.

name: Folding Entrenching Spade
notes: Doubles as a close combat weapon: bonus +1, base Damage 2.

name: Folding Winch
notes: Used with rope, no MOBILITY roll is needed to climb up or down.

name: Polymer Climbing Rope
notes: 45 m abrasion-resistant line (acid still eats it).

name: F3S Full Spectrum Spotter Scope
notes: Spotter rolls OBSERVATION once; each success gives the sniper +1, as long as neither moves or is attacked.

name: PDT/L Personal Data Transmitter Bracelet/Locator Tube Set
notes: Wrist PDT plus a locator tube that homes in on it within ~100 m (four zones).

name: M73PX Parafoil
notes: Packable glider: donning is a slow action, deploying fast; Speed 3, steered with PILOTING.

name: Handcuffs
notes: Named only in ACM starting gear; no stat line given.

name: Survival Kit
notes: Named only in ACM starting gear; no stat line given.
